subject: A censure motion against Jeremy Rockliff has passed, making him the first premier to be censured by the Tasmanian parliament.

Tasmanian Premier censured for handling of scandals.

Censure motion against Jeremy Rockliff passes parliament
Evidence: premier's apology, ministerial resignations, parliamentary vote

A censure motion against Tasmanian Premier Jeremy Rockliff has passed parliament due to his handling of scandals involving ministerial resignations, marking a historic first for a Tasmanian premier.

The censure motion against Premier Rockliff passed parliament, highlighting his failure to uphold the ministerial code of conduct following two resignations. This symbolic motion carries no penalty but signifies parliamentary disapproval.
